messages.content: The room is confirmed for Friday through Monday, but the confirmation says valet parking is $35 a night. We had been using $10. Please sort out what changed before I send this to my spouse.

The $10 figure came from the earlier comparison and is not the hotel’s current parking rate. El Sendero has confirmed that its only on-site option is valet at $35 per night, and it will not honor the lower figure. For three nights, that is $105 rather than $30, raising the estimated stay total from about $805 to about $880, before any tax applied specifically to parking.
How does that compare with the public garage for the whole weekend? We will need the car for Saturday’s gathering.

The nearby garage is cheaper by posted daily rates, but one ticket cannot cover an overnight stay with exit and reentry. You would need to settle the first parking period when leaving Saturday, take a new ticket on return, and pay again when departing Monday. It should still cost less than $105, but the exact total depends on the entry and exit times, and overnight space is not guaranteed.
That sounds awkward with luggage on Friday. Can the hotel take the car even if we arrive before the room is ready?

Yes. The hotel will accept the car and hold your luggage before the 3:00 p.m. check-in time. Valet billing begins when the car is received Friday; there is no separate early-arrival handling fee. You can retrieve it Saturday and return it that evening without starting an additional nightly charge.
Then keep valet for all three nights. I don’t want to move bags through a garage or deal with separate tickets. What should Friday look like so the 6:30 dinner is not tight?

Leave Denver at 7:00 a.m. and retain the planned fuel and lunch stop. Aim to reach El Sendero between 1:45 and 2:30 p.m. Pull directly into the hotel’s valet area, hand over the keys, and leave the bags with the desk if the room is not ready. Even with a 3:00 p.m. arrival, you should have ample time to check in, change, and walk to the dinner.
Give me a fallback if traffic pushes us later than that.

If the updated arrival estimate slips past 4:30 p.m., call the hotel from the road to confirm late arrival and ask valet to receive the car immediately. On arrival, leave the luggage with the desk and postpone taking it to the room; check in, take only what you need, and leave on foot by about 6:10 p.m. The room remains confirmed for Friday through Monday, one room for two adults with one queen bed, and the working total is now about $880 with three nights of valet.
